evals.prompt: Verify my_work/extraction.csv against the texts in activity/data/fulltext/.
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_quotes.py, then a semantic check of quote_found rows (population, period, direction, magnitude), an absence check of not reported rows, and writes verification.csv with support values.
expectations: Runs verify_quotes.py and reports counts per status
Checks direction and magnitude, not only presence of the quote
Searches the text for each not reported field

evals.prompt: Fact-check this paragraph of our discussion that cites Phan 2020 and Mestre 2012.
evals.expected_output: Checks one cited source at a time with all sentences citing it, classifies supported/overstated/unsupported/unverifiable with verbatim passages.
expectations: Gives a verbatim supporting passage or says it cannot be found
Uses unverifiable when the source text is not available

evals.prompt: This value looks right to me from what I remember of the paper, can you just mark it verified?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to verify from memory; verification needs the source text.
expectations: Does not mark a value verified without the source text
